## Problem
Concrete reading failure or maintenance need; use sanitized evidence.

## Change
Smallest behavior change and why.

## Validation
- [ ] node scripts/validate.mjs
- [ ] Relevant behavioral cases executed, or explicitly marked not_run with reason
- [ ] Raw evidence and model/skill revision recorded
- [ ] An unrelated mode checked for regression when behavior changes
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated when needed
- [ ] No private data or unlicensed content
